text:
ella: quick flag: hummingbird-v2-int8 canary shows a weird retry paradox for funcall outputs. first attempt streams a complete array, but our client-side retry sometimes returns a shorter array (missing last item) even though server logs show full emission.

raj: do we see this only after our retry/backoff kicks in or on initial stream too?

ella: initial stream OK for most seeds. failures correlate with the SDK retry path: when the SDK detects a parse failure and re-invokes, the second response occasionally omits the trailing element. non-stream re-invoke returns full array.

nina: hypothesis: we might be reusing request-id or token-seed on retry causing the kernel to pick a deterministic but truncated generation path under low-latency mode. can you paste the request-id and seed for a failing sample?

miles: also ask runtime team if retries reuse the same RNG/state token or if we accidentally reuse a truncated KV cache for the retried worker. that would explain deterministic truncation.

ella: sample: req=hb-9f3, seed=777, initial stream assembled: 3 items. retry (sdk) assembled: 2 items. server emission logs for req=hb-9f3 show 3 items emitted both times. puzzling.

canary-bot: alert: model=hummingbird-v2-int8 canary: retry-truncated-funcall 0.6% (baseline 0.05%) details: https://canary.redwood/alerts/6532109876

raj: quick plan: (1) add per-request seed+req-uuid to retry invocation so kernel sees distinct id (raj), (2) instrument SDK to dump raw chunk bytes for both initial and retry for failing reqs (ella), (3) run 5k seeded replay toggling streaming on/off and with/without retry to reproduce at scale (nina).

miles: runtime check: i'll audit KV cache reuse paths and confirm whether retry reuse can surface stale kvcache pointers. if so, patch to clone cache for retried jobs.

ella: i'll enable enhanced trace label=retry-paradox-653210 and start the 5k replay now. will post one raw chunk-dump here when available.

nina: if we reproduce, we should gate retry fallback for hummingbird-v2-int8 in canary until patch lands.

raj: agreed. thanks team. short and targeted; ping when you have a failing chunk dump.
